children.name: Near-black theme, same hierarchy and token names as Light. Primary actions invert to cream, surfaces step up in grey and thin borders replace shadows. On the Starter plan a collection can only hold one mode, so the dark values live in their own collection: Semantic · Dark. To make a screen dark, rebind each Semantic token to the token of the same name in Semantic · Dark.
